press_references.value: AD Ports boosts Middle Corridor strategy with Black Sea deal

partnership_announcements.description: AD Ports Group signed a partnership agreement with Romania's National Company Maritime Ports Administration to collaborate on developing Port of Constanta and deploy digital and sustainable port solutions, strengthening AD Ports' Middle Corridor trade strategy and access to Eastern and Central Europe.

press_references.value: Abu Dhabi Airports signs partnership with The Butterfly to advance inclusivity, accessibility and guest experience

partnership_announcements.description: Abu Dhabi Airports entered a strategic partnership with inclusion and accessibility specialist The Butterfly to enhance inclusive recruitment, workplace accessibility, and guest experience for People of Determination across its airport network.

press_references.value: Lionsbridge Investments Limited and AD Ports Group Sign MoU to Explore Port Services Development for the Osiris Phosphoric Acid Facility

partnership_announcements.description: AD Ports Group and Lionsbridge Investments signed an MoU to explore jointly developing and operating port services and logistics infrastructure to support Osiris Phosphate’s planned USD 1.2B phosphoric acid facility in Safaga, Egypt.

press_references.value: AD Ports signs Dhs2.47 billion land sale deal with Mira Developments

partnership_announcements.description: AD Ports Group announced a new strategic partnership with Mira Developments via a AED 2.47 billion land sale and development agreement to build a large mixed-use community in Abu Dhabi's Al Mamoura district over the next decade.

press_references.value: SNG: AD Ports, Emirates Food Industries in deal to set up $544mln industrial complex

partnership_announcements.description: AD Ports Group and Emirates Food Industries announced a strategic partnership to develop a $544 million industrial complex for grain storage and processing at Khalifa Port, supporting UAE food security.

press_references.value: AD Ports Group, ASRY sign three heads of terms to collaborate on strategic maritime, ports projects

partnership_announcements.description: AD Ports Group and ASRY signed three heads of terms to collaborate on strategic maritime and ports projects, including a joint venture for drydock management, green ship recycling with JM Baxi, and joint investment opportunities in ports and terminals.

press_references.value: Pakistan-UAE trade crosses $10.9b mark in the fiscal year of 2023–24

partnership_announcements.description: Abu Dhabi Ports Company and DP World have signed agreements for port operations, including the development of Karachi Port Trust and related railway infrastructure projects in Pakistan.

press_references.value: AD Ports Group awards three contracts for Noatum Ports Pointe-Noire Terminal in Congo

partnership_announcements.description: AD Ports Group, through a majority-owned joint venture with CMA CGM's subsidiary CMA Terminals, is jointly developing the new Noatum Ports Pointe-Noire container terminal in the Republic of the Congo under a long-term concession.

press_references.value: Trans-Caspian Transport Route Cargo Volumes Increase Fivefold in Seven Years

partnership_announcements.description: Abu Dhabi Ports Group and Kazakhstan’s Port of Kuryk are jointly developing the Sarzha multifunctional terminal, a five-million-ton-capacity facility supporting the Trans-Caspian corridor.
